# T-2: Gate upgrade evidence

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Make integration gate require and validate upgrade-result.json only when the diff includes upgrade-required source paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- gate fails when upgrade-required changes exist and artifact is missing
- gate fails when artifact result is failed
- gate fails when checkedPaths does not exactly match the current sorted unique matched paths from UPGRADE_REQUIRED_SOURCE_PATTERNS
- gate passes the upgrade check when no upgrade-required changes exist

## Implementation Notes
Focus on src/flow/lib/run-gate.js and helper logic in src/flow/lib/test-artifacts.js. Detection must use baseBranch...HEAD diff and the exact UPGRADE_REQUIRED_SOURCE_PATTERNS path set from requirements R3/R4.

## Test Strategy
Spec tests under specs/278-upgrade-result-artifact/tests/ with // spec: R<N> headers around the gate precheck helper using temp specs and synthetic changed-file lists.
